title: Back Blows (Airway Obstruction)
content_markdown:
#### Indications

- Complete upper airway obstruction due to foreign body (conscious patient only).

#### Procedure

- Have the patient lean over so the patient’s head is lower than their chest, if possible (see **Figure 1**). 
- A child may be positioned across your knees or arm (infant) (see **Figure 2**)

- Apply four forceful back blows to the centre of the back, between the shoulder blades using the heel of one hand in a forwards (towards the head) motion.

- Assess the airway after each back blow to determine if the obstruction has been dislodged.

**Note:** this procedure is generally only administered to a conscious patient. If unconscious utilise chest thrusts and laryngoscope.
